notes.title: June-July Playtest Registration
notes.content:
SteelFront needs your help! We will begin a series of demo playtests starting on the 27th. They will not have a predetermined end date, rather we expect them to guide us along the course of development.


Although you will be able to request access through the Steam Store page as normal, registering through the following form may give you anticipated access.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45667373/e38a6305e9bfb31c7ce346c221f660a066acd372.png"]
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfT26nXdIdmjjQo4-BqGhgq0MNEamHmHiXxZvDG2JQzBuPaOg/viewform

DISCLAIMER: We reserve the right to select users based on internal priorities, with all submissions reviewed manually. Users who are accepted are not entitled to a full copy of the game, the demo version may be closed and/or removed at any point in the development process.Access to the playtests might be temporarily stopped due to technical issues and/or delays.
